moreNFL Draft guidesSports statistics softwareSalary cap analysis toolsSports memorabiliaExcel training courses Contract NotesMyles Garrett signed a four year, $160 million contract extension with the Browns. $123.596 million is guaranteed of which $88.8 million is fully guaranteed at signing including a $21.54 million signing bonus. Garrett's 2025 and 2026 base salaries are fully guaranteed as is $29.5 million of his 2027 salary. Garrett has $1 million in annual workout bonuses that are guaranteed in the first three years of the contract as well as $1 million in per game roster bonuses that are fully guaranteed in the first three years of the contract. If on the roster on the 3rd day of the 2026 league year the remainder of his 2027 salary is fully guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2027 league year Garrett will earn a full guarantee on his 2028 base salary. If on the roster on the 3rd day of the 2028 league year, $800,000 of his 2029 salary is fully guaranteed. There are non guaranteed workout bonuses and per game bonuses in the final three years of the contract. The Browns have the right to exercise options in March of 2026, 2027, and 2028. These options are already reflected in the cap charges.
